cpp_engine.name: C++ Engine
cpp_engine.description: C++ engine with source, headers, assets, tests, and CMake

files.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(HyperMaxEngine LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

add_executable(app src/main.cpp)
target_include_directories(app PRIVATE include)
files.Makefile:
BUILD = build

.PHONY: all configure build run clean

all: build

configure:
	cmake -S . -B $(BUILD)

build: configure
	cmake --build $(BUILD)

run: build
	./$(BUILD)/app

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)

python_app.name: Python Application
python_app.description: Python application with tests and project metadata

files.Makefile:
PYTHON = python3

.PHONY: all build run test clean

all: build

build:
	$(PYTHON) -m compileall -q src

run:
	$(PYTHON) src/main.py

test:
	$(PYTHON) -m unittest discover -s tests

clean:
	rm -rf build dist __pycache__ src/__pycache__ tests/__pycache__

c_application.name: C Application
c_application.description: C application using Make and CMake

files.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(HyperMaxApp LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_executable(app src/main.c)
target_include_directories(app PRIVATE include)
files.Makefile:
CC = cc
CFLAGS = -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
BUILD = build
TARGET = $(BUILD)/app

.PHONY: all build run test clean

all: build

build:
	mkdir -p $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) src/main.c -o $(TARGET)

run: build
	./$(TARGET)

test:
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -fsyntax-only src/main.c

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)

javascript_app.name: JavaScript Application
javascript_app.description: Node.js application with built-in test support

files.Makefile:
NODE = node

.PHONY: all build run test clean

all: build

build:
	$(NODE) --check src/main.js

run:
	$(NODE) src/main.js

test:
	$(NODE) --test

clean:
	rm -rf build dist coverage

CARGO = cargo

.PHONY: all build run test clean

all: build

build:
	$(CARGO) build

run:
	$(CARGO) run

test:
	$(CARGO) test

clean:
	$(CARGO) clean
